chunks: When their brother Lot said to them: 'Will you not take heed?'

key_terms.أَخُوهُمْ: Their brother, indicating a close kinship or shared lineage
key_terms.تَتَّقُونَ: You take heed / You practice Taqwa (God-consciousness)
key_terms.لُوطٌ: Lot, the Prophet sent to the people of Sodom and Gomorrah

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Lot say to his people to urge them to be mindful of God?
ai.summary: In the Surah of the Poets, this verse emphasizes the intimate, kinship-based authority of Prophet Lot (peace be upon him) as he calls his people to Taqwa, a theme particularly resonant in Shia exegesis which highlights the continuity of prophetic guidance. The address 'their brother' underscores the social and spiritual closeness required for effective moral persuasion, linking the narrative to the broader Quranic motif of prophets as relatable guides rather than distant figures.
